## Checklist

- [ ] I edited **only** files in `data/deals/` (never `README.md` — it is generated).
- [ ] One vendor per PR (max 3 deals for that vendor).
- [ ] `url` is the vendor's **official** page — no affiliate links, referral codes, `utm_*`/`ref`/`via` parameters or link shorteners.
- [ ] The offer is stated on the vendor's own official page.
- [ ] The deal is **publicly available** (no invite-only, email-gated or private codes) and is a real Black Friday / Cyber Monday 2026 offer, not an everyday price.
- [ ] I checked the deal myself today and set `verified_on`. Unknown discount values or end dates are `null`, not guessed.
- [ ] `deal_description` is factual, under 160 characters, no hype words, emoji, exclamation marks or ALL CAPS.
- [ ] **Disclosure:** I am not affiliated with this vendor — **or** I set `disclosure.affiliated: true` with my relationship.
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally.
